preservation_controls.description: Unmodified input passthrough; exact identity control.
Only the noise-only pause segment is attenuated to one quarter; speech samples are unchanged.
Only the initial clean speech segment is attenuated to one tenth; all other samples are unchanged.
Every sample is halved; SI-SDR is scale invariant while SNR and level change detect it.
Constant +500 Q15 offset with saturation at the Q15 boundary; SI-SDR ignores it after centering.
Every sample is hard-bounded to +/-8000 Q15; full-scale clipping is still zero.
